name: JF Remote
description: Control any Jellyfin session from your phone: playstate, trickplay seeking, segment skip, tracks/quality/speed, episode browsing, watch-along.

name: Filler Skip
description: On-screen skip-filler button (web) plus per-user opt-in auto-skip on autoplay (all remote-controllable clients). AnimeFillerList-driven; matches Anime Filler Marker renames when present.
overview: Skip anime filler to the next canon episode

name: JavaScript Injector
description: Unofficial Jellyfin 12.0 build of n00bcodr's JavaScript Injector, compiled from upstream source. Required for Filler Skip's web button and JF Remote's still-watching integration. On Jellyfin 10.x install it from the author's own repository instead.
overview: Inject custom JavaScript into the web client (12.0 build)

name: File Transformation
description: Unofficial Jellyfin 12.0 build of IAmParadox27's File Transformation (upstream v12 branch). Web-asset transformation backbone used by JavaScript Injector, Intro Skipper and others. On Jellyfin 10.x install it from the author's own repository instead.

name: Download Time
description: Detects missing episodes (gaps you missed and new releases not yet downloaded) and missing franchise movies, using each item's identifying source (TVDB/AniDB/TMDB). Dashboard report, poster badges, optional native missing-episode placeholders.
